content: Anatumi Nakama Elyape Keta Pisinya Lao Purisi Dupwame Larami
Kamongome Mosese kando dopa lamaiyuo, Eronemoo banya ikinyingi dusipape
Isaraele wambu dupwa nyuo elyape keta pisinya lao pii dapakale lena lamairi, leya.

content.text: Kamongome nakama nyuo elyape keta piso isaro pyuo pinya.
Kamongo baame anjiki pyuo ipyapala mona keyange palyuo nakama keta pyakao karena.
Kamongome nakama kando rae maiyuo poraiyuo suu pyao nakama mona kyuu lao singi renge doko jinya.

content: Kamongome dopa lao, Mendeme nambana kingi lao Isaraele wambu dupwa elyape keta pisinya lao ateŋa larami ramo dokopa nambame nakama nyuo elyape keta pisaroko, leya.
7:1—9:14 Wambu dupwame bange dupwa Anatu keta maiyami Lipae akali dupwa yapasi ingyuo purisi yulu pirami lao rombo palyiyami. Yuu kyau Sainai dokona Pasopa Nenge Nenge neyami.
